data.content_ref: inline:The target claims the isolated artifact 'shares mechanism' with SRC_003 via causal sensitivity to falsification, but the two mechanisms differ in their causal structure in a way that undermines the shared-mechanism relation: SRC_003's mechanism is population-level statistical power (variance reduction over many trials), whereas the isolated artifact's mechanism is within-trail causal-path coverage. These do not share a causal mechanism; they share only a superficial goal (sensitivity to falsification). The causal drivers are distinct — one is a sampling mechanism, the other a graph-tracing mechanism — so the asserted relation of a shared mechanism is not substantiated, only a re-description of the endpoints under a common label.
